disposition_reason: Figure 5 defines a defensible original 24-joint decoding task and author code fixes its variance-explained calculation, but the published per-joint/per-mouse numerical baseline has not been recovered or rerun. The current scorer compares to a newly authored phase template and aggregates differently from the paper; beating that template is not beating the paper.

source_paper.title: Mouse sensorimotor cortex reflects complex kinematic details during reaching and grasping

evidence.locator: Version of Record; Figure 5 A–H; Methods: Joint angle and velocity decoding
evidence.supports: Original joint-angle reconstruction, five-mouse comparison, 90/10 trial splits repeated 50 times, input processing and figure aggregation.

evidence.locator: Cross-validation partition loop and VEs assignments
evidence.supports: Trial-level modulo splits and VE = 1 - var(test residual)/var(test target), not uncentered SSE-based R-squared.
Source pre-CV neural PCA and nPartitions=10, nFolds=5: the implementation loops five repetitions of ten held-out partitions despite potentially confusing variable names.
Pins five mice, their ten M1/S1 sessions, RADICaL and deconvolved branches, and source RNG seed.
Uses lift-locked -100 to 400 ms and top 100 lift-modulated cells; instantaneous and lagged branches are distinct.
Connects the source figure implementation to Figshare 28326998.
Local normalized scorer preserves source VE but its phase-template delta, fold/joint reduction and equal-mouse summary are prospective choices.

target.description: Decode all 24 forelimb joint-angle trajectories from M1-fl and S1-fl neural activity for the original Figure 5 reaching/grasping task. Joint velocities, lagged variants and optogenetic disruption are separate analyses.

dataset.description: Author repository points to Figshare DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.28326998; the exact article-version/file set and all source preprocessed RADICaL inputs must be frozen before a same-task comparison.

cohort.description: All five source mice cfa17, cfa19, cfa20, cfa22 and cfa24, one M1 and one S1 session each, as explicitly listed in fig5_analysis.m; retain all original eligible trials and 24 joints.

split.description: Source RNG 240926; cvRegress uses five successive random trial permutations, each split into ten non-overlapping modulo groups for 90/10 train/test, 50 fits total. Bind the resulting original trial IDs rather than create a new animal-held-out task. The source algorithm and RNG are verified, but exact trial ordering and resulting original fold membership have not been authenticated.

inputs.description: The Figure 5 primary branch uses RADICaL-inferred rates of the top 100 lift-modulated cells per session. The deconvolved and lagged predictor branches are separately reported; they cannot be substituted without matching the corresponding original comparison.

preprocessing.description: Joint angles are interpolated and smoothed with 15-ms Gaussian SD; source window is -100 to +400 ms from lift. RADICaL rates are unsmoothed; source neural PCA retains 90% of neuron count before decoder CV. Keep this preprocessing exposure explicit.

metric.description: For every joint and held-out fold, VE = 1 - Var(y - yhat)/Var(y), with MATLAB sample-variance semantics over concatenated test-trial timepoints. Higher is better. This differs from 1 - SSE/SST when residual means are nonzero.

aggregation.description: Figure 5 A/E displays fold distributions per joint; D/H uses each joint median over folds and per-mouse medians across proximal or distal joints. Preserve this source panel; a new pooled phase-template delta is not the paper score.

comparison.primary_metric: Figure 5 held-out variance explained per joint and source mouse/area summary

published_baseline.description: The paper presents distributions and mouse/joint summaries graphically; no exact numeric source VE vector or justified single scalar was recovered. Do not digitize an approximate figure as a numeric gold baseline.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Source fig5_analysis -> loadDecode -> decode -> cvRegress is a reproducible author-baseline route, but no complete authentic data run, prediction vector or original-fold metric agreement has been established.

minimum_effect.rationale: Calibrate source score variability and joint-angle measurement limits before specifying a meaningful VE gain; no universal increase or selective joint threshold is justified.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired mouse-level inference with the original per-joint/fold score panel retained; repeated CV folds are correlated and joints within a mouse are not independent replicates.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Five mice; M1 and S1 sessions are paired within mouse.
uncertainty.rationale: A two-area and proximal/distal decision must account for its multiple endpoints without silently replacing the original summaries.

paper_win_requires: Recover the numeric original Figure 5 score panel and reproduce the source author decoder on all ten sessions and all 24 joints.
Bind original folds, RADICaL inputs, cell selection, PCA exposure and exact source VE formula before candidate iteration.
Predeclare the source-summary comparison and meaningful effect/uncertainty so a favorable subset of joints, mice or areas cannot establish success.
A lower reconstruction error to saved figures, a gain over the local phase template, a new split or the separate optogenetic histogram does not establish a source-paper win.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was reviewed or claimed; source-paper and author-rerun comparisons are separate.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked pending the original score panel and matched source route. Subsequent method iteration must use training and designated validation feedback under the declared source input condition.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze all trial identifiers, cell-selection and PCA choices, source fold manifest, candidate method, original summary comparison and uncertainty rule before final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Compare both methods on identical original folds and all eligible mouse/area/joint outputs; retain per-mouse paired results and source figure reductions. New held-animal evaluation is an extension.
episode.baseline_policy: The author ridge/RADICaL decoder is the baseline. The locally authored phase template is a diagnostic control, not the published method, and has no authority to define paper victory.

blocking_issues: Numeric published per-joint/mouse VE baseline and exact comparable scalar or multivariate decision remain unrecovered.
Complete versioned source inputs and original fold manifest have not been authenticated or executed.
Current normalized scorer lacks source neural fitting/PCA/ROI/ridge parity and uses a prospective comparator/aggregation.
Meaningful effect, small-sample mouse-level uncertainty, concrete access/resource budgets and working same-task admission remain unfinished.

legacy.notes: Retain normalized joint-angle scorer and optogenetic timing component. Their local phase-template delta and prospective equal-mouse inference are useful diagnostics but do not replace the original Figure 5 method or performance baseline.
